verses.text_uthmani: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ

trs.20: Ṣād.<sup foot_note=197209>1</sup> By the Qur’ān containing reminder...<sup foot_note=197208>2</sup>
trs.85: Sad By the Quran with its reminding . . .!
trs.22: Sad: By the Qur'an, Full of Admonition: (This is the Truth).
trs.203:
Sâd.
[These letters (Sâd etc.) are one of the miracles of the Quran and none but Allah (Alone) knows their meanings]. By the Quran full of reminding.

verses.text_uthmani: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ

trs.20: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
trs.85: Yet the disbelievers are steeped in arrogance and hostility.
trs.22: But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
trs.203: Nay, those who disbelieve are in false pride and opposition.

verses.text_uthmani: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ

trs.20: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
trs.85: How many generations We have destroyed before them! They all cried out, once it was too late, for escape.
trs.22: How many generations before them did We destroy? In the end they cried (for mercy)- when there was no longer time for being saved!
trs.203: How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape.

verses.text_uthmani: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ

trs.20: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
trs.85: The disbelievers think it strange that a prophet of their own people has come to warn them: they say, ‘He is just a lying sorcerer.
trs.22: So they wonder that a Warner has come to them from among themselves! and the Unbelievers say, "This is a sorcerer telling lies!
trs.203: And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: "This (Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) is a sorcerer, a liar.

verses.text_uthmani: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ

trs.20: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
trs.85: How can he claim that all the gods are but one God? What an astonishing thing [to claim]!’
trs.22: "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
trs.203: "Has he made the âlihah (gods) (all) into One Ilâh (God - Allâh). Verily, this is a curious thing!"

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ

trs.20: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.<sup foot_note=197210>1</sup>
trs.85: Their leaders depart, saying, ‘Walk away! Stay faithful to your gods! That is what you must do.
trs.22: And the leader among them go away (impatiently), (saying), "Walk ye away, and remain constant to your gods! For this is truly a thing designed (against you)!
trs.203: And the leaders among them went about (saying): "Go on, and remain constant to your âlihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!

verses.text_uthmani: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ

trs.20: We have not heard of this in the latest religion.<sup foot_note=197211>1</sup> This is not but a fabrication.
trs.85: We did not hear any such claim in the last religion: it is all an invention.
trs.22: "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
trs.203: "We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsir Al-Qurtubi]

verses.text_uthmani: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ

trs.20: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
trs.85: Was the message sent only to him out of all of us?’ In fact they doubt My warning; in fact they have not tasted My punishment yet.
trs.22: "What! has the Message been sent to him - (Of all persons) among us?"... but they are in doubt concerning My (Own) Message! Nay, they have not yet tasted My Punishment!
trs.203: "Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?" Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ân)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ

trs.20: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?<sup foot_note=197212>1</sup>
trs.85: Do they possess the treasures of your Lord’s bounty, the Mighty, the All Giving?
trs.22: Or have they the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord,- the Exalted in Power, the Grantor of Bounties without measure?
trs.203: Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ

trs.20: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.<sup foot_note=197213>1</sup>
trs.85: Do they control the heavens and earth and everything between? Let them climb their ropes:
trs.22: Or have they the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all between? If so, let them mount up with the ropes and means (to reach that end)!
trs.203: Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!

verses.text_uthmani: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ

trs.20: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
trs.85: their armed alliance is weak and will be crushed.
trs.22: But there - will be put to flight even a host of confederates.
trs.203: (As they denied Allâh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated).

verses.text_uthmani: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ

trs.20: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,<sup foot_note=197214>1</sup>
trs.85: The people of Noah, Ad, and firmly-supported Pharaoh rejected their prophets before them.
trs.22: Before them (were many who) rejected messengers,- the people of Noah, and 'Ad, and Pharaoh, the Lord of Stakes,
trs.203: Before them (were many who) belied (Messengers) - the people of Nûh (Noah); and ‘Âd; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),

verses.text_uthmani: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ

trs.20: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.<sup foot_note=197215>1</sup>
trs.85: Thamud, the people of Lot, and the Forest-Dwellers each formed opposition [against theirs].
trs.22: And Thamud, and the people of Lut, and the Companions of the Wood; - such were the Confederates.
trs.203: And Thamûd, and the people of Lût (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates.

verses.text_uthmani: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ

trs.20: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
trs.85: They all rejected the mes-sengers and they were deservedly struck by My punishment:
trs.22: Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
trs.203: Not one of them but belied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ

trs.20: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.<sup foot_note=197216>1</sup>
trs.85: all the disbelievers here are waiting for is a single blast that cannot be postponed.
trs.22: These (today) only wait for a single mighty Blast, which (when it comes) will brook no delay.
trs.203: And these only wait for a single Saihah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrâfil -)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till everything will perish except Allâh (the only God full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour)].

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

trs.20: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."
trs.85: They say, ‘Our Lord! Advance us our share of punishment before the Day of Reckoning!’
trs.22: They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
trs.203: They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittanâ (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"

verses.text_uthmani: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

trs.20: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].
trs.85: Bear their words patiently [Prophet]. Remember Our servant David, a man of strength who always turned to Us:
trs.22: Have patience at what they say, and remember our servant David, the man of strength: for he ever turned (to Allah).
trs.203: Be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dâwûd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft-returning in all matters and in repentance (toward Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ

trs.20: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
trs.85: We made the mountains join him in glorifying Us at sunset and sunrise;
trs.22: It was We that made the hills declare, in unison with him, Our Praises, at eventide and at break of day,
trs.203: Verily, We made the mountains to glorify Our Praises with him [Dâwûd (David)] in the ‘Ashî (i.e. after the mid-day till sunset) and Ishrâq (i.e. after the sunrise till mid-day).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

trs.20: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
trs.85: and the birds, too, in flocks, all echoed his praise.
trs.22: And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
trs.203: And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dâwûd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allâh’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsir Al-Qurtubi ).

verses.text_uthmani: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ

trs.20: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
trs.85: We strengthened his kingdom; We gave him wisdom and a decisive way of speaking.
trs.22: We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and sound judgment in speech and decision.
trs.203: We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Hikmah (Prophethood) and sound judgement in speech and decision.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ

trs.20: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
trs.85: Have you heard the story of the two litigants who climbed into his private quarters?
trs.22: Has the Story of the Disputants reached thee? Behold, they climbed over the wall of the private chamber;
trs.203: And has the news of the litigants reached you? When they climbed over the wall into (his) Mihrâb (a praying place or a private room);

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ

trs.20: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
trs.85: When they reached David, he took fright, but they said, ‘Do not be afraid. We are two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other: judge between us fairly- do not be unjust- and guide us to the right path.
trs.22: When they entered the presence of David, and he was terrified of them, they said: "Fear not: we are two disputants, one of whom has wronged the other: Decide now between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, but guide us to the even Path..
trs.203: When they entered in upon Dâwûd (David), he was terrified of them. They said: "Fear not! (We are) two litigants, one of whom has wronged the other, therefore judge between us with truth, and treat us not with injustice, and guide us to the Right Way.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ

trs.20: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
trs.85: This is my brother. He had ninety-nine ewes and I just the one, and he said, “Let me take charge of her,” and overpowered me with his words.’
trs.22: "This man is my brother: He has nine and ninety ewes, and I have (but) one: Yet he says, 'commit her to my care,' and is (moreover) harsh to me in speech."
trs.203: Verily, this my brother (in religion) has ninety-nine ewes, while I have (only) one ewe, and he says: "Hand it over to me, and he overpowered me in speech."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩

trs.20: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord<sup foot_note=197217>1</sup> and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].
trs.85: David said, ‘He has done you wrong by demanding to add your ewe to his flock. Many partners treat each other unfairly. Those who sincerely believe and do good deeds do not do this, but these are very few.’ [Then] David realized that We had been testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness, fell down on his knees, and repented:
trs.22: (David) said: "He has undoubtedly wronged thee in demanding thy (single) ewe to be added to his (flock of) ewes: truly many are the partners (in business) who wrong each other: Not so do those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, and how few are they?"... and David gathered that We had tried him: he asked forgiveness of his Lord, fell down, bowing (in prostration), and turned (to Allah in repentance).
trs.203: [Dâwûd (David)] said (immediately without listening to the opponent): "He has wronged you in demanding your ewe in addition to his ewes. And, verily, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and they are few." And Dâwûd (David) guessed that We have tried him and he sought Forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate and turned (to Allâh) in repentance.

verses.text_uthmani: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

trs.20: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
trs.85: We forgave him [his misdeed]. His reward will be nearness to Us, a good place to return to.
trs.22: So We forgave him this (lapse): he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful place of (Final) Return.
trs.203: So We forgave him that, and verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good place of (final) return (Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ

trs.20: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
trs.85: ‘David, We have given you mastery over the land. Judge fairly between people. Do not follow your desires, lest they divert you from God’s path: those who wander from His path will have a painful torment because they ignore the Day of Reckoning.’
trs.22: O David! We did indeed make thee a vicegerent on earth: so judge thou between men in truth (and justice): Nor follow thou the lusts (of thy heart), for they will mislead thee from the Path of Allah: for those who wander astray from the Path of Allah, is a Penalty Grievous, for that they forget the Day of Account.
trs.203: O Dâwûd (David)! Verily! We have placed you as a successor on the earth; so judge you between men in truth (and justice) and follow not your desire - for it will mislead you from the Path of Allâh. Verily, those who wander astray from the Path of Allâh (shall) have a severe torment, because they forgot the Day of Reckoning.

translation.text: for it will lead you astray

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ

trs.20: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
trs.85: It was not without purpose that We created the heavens and the earth and everything in between. That may be what the disbelievers assume- how they will suffer from the Fire!-
trs.22: Not without purpose did We create heaven and earth and all between! that were the thought of Unbelievers! but woe to the Unbelievers because of the Fire (of Hell)!
trs.203: And We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them without purpose! That is the consideration of those who disbelieve! Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Islâmic Monotheism) from the Fire!

verses.text_uthmani: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ

trs.20: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?
trs.85: but would We treat those who believe and do good deeds and those who spread corruption on earth as equal? Would We treat those who are aware of God and those who recklessly break all bounds in the same way?
trs.22: Shall We treat those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, the same as those who do mischief on earth? Shall We treat those who guard against evil, the same as those who turn aside from the right?
trs.203: Shall We treat those who believe (in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds as Mufsidûn (those who associate partners in worship with Allâh and commit crimes) on earth? Or shall We treat the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) as the Fujjâr (criminals, disbelievers, the wicked)?

verses.text_uthmani: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

trs.20: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
trs.85: This is a blessed Scripture which We sent down to you [Muhammad], for people to think about its messages, and for those with understanding to take heed.
trs.22: (Here is) a Book which We have sent down unto thee, full of blessings, that they may mediate on its Signs, and that men of understanding may receive admonition.
trs.203: (This is) a Book (the Qur’ân) which We have sent down to you, full of blessings, that they may ponder over its Verses, and that men of understanding may remember.

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

trs.20: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
trs.85: We gave David Solomon. He was an excellent servant who always turned to God.
trs.22: To David We gave Solomon (for a son),- How excellent in Our service! Ever did he turn (to Us)!
trs.203: And to Dâwûd (David) We gave Sulaimân (Solomon). How excellent a slave! Verily, he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ

trs.20: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
trs.85: When well-bred light-footed horses were paraded before him near the close of day,
trs.22: Behold, there were brought before him, at eventide coursers of the highest breeding, and swift of foot;
trs.203: When there were displayed before him, in the afternoon, well trained horses of the highest breed [for Jihâd (holy fighting in Allâh’s Cause)].

verses.text_uthmani: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ

trs.20: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
trs.85: he kept saying, ‘My love of fine things is part of my remembering my Lord!’ until [the horses] disappeared from sight-
trs.22: And he said, "Truly do I love the love of good, with a view to the glory of my Lord,"- until (the sun) was hidden in the veil (of night):
trs.203: He said: "I did love the good (these horses) instead of remembering my Lord (in my ‘Asr prayer)" till the time was over, and (the sun) had hidden in the veil (of night).

verses.text_uthmani: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ

trs.20: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking<sup foot_note=197218>1</sup> [their] legs and necks.
trs.85: ‘Bring them back!’ [he said] and started to stroke their legs and necks.
trs.22: "Bring them back to me." then began he to pass his hand over (their) legs and their necks.
trs.203: Then he said "Bring them (horses) back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (till the end of the display).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ

trs.20: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body;<sup foot_note=197220>1</sup> then he returned.<sup foot_note=197219>2</sup>
trs.85: We certainly tested Solomon, reducing him to a mere skeleton on his throne.
trs.22: And We did try Solomon: We placed on his throne a body (without life); but he did turn (to Us in true devotion):
trs.203: And indeed, We did try Sulaimân (Solomon) and We placed on his throne Jasad (a devil, so he lost his kingdom for a while) and he did return (to Allâh with obedience and in repentance, and to his throne and kingdom by the Grace of Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
trs.85: He turned to Us and prayed: ‘Lord forgive me! Grant me such power as no one after me will have- You are the Most Generous Provider.’
trs.22: He said, "O my Lord! Forgive me, and grant me a kingdom which, (it may be), suits not another after me: for Thou art the Grantor of Bounties (without measure).
trs.203: He said: "My Lord! Forgive me, and bestow upon me a kingdom such as shall not belong to any other after me: Verily, You are the Bestower."

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ

trs.20: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
trs.85: So We gave him power over the wind, which at his request ran gently wherever he willed,
trs.22: Then We subjected the wind to his power, to flow gently to his order, Whithersoever he willed,-
trs.203: So, We subjected to him the wind; it blew gently by his order whithersoever he willed,

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ

trs.20: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.
trs.85: and the jinn––every kind of builder and diver
trs.22: As also the evil ones, (including) every kind of builder and diver,-
trs.203: And also the Shayâtîn (devils) from the jinn (including) every kind of builder and diver,

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ

trs.20: And others bound together in irons.
trs.85: and others chained in fetters.
trs.22: As also others bound together in fetters.
trs.203: And also others bound in fetters.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ

trs.20: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
trs.85: ‘This is Our gift, so give or withhold as you wish without account.’
trs.22: "Such are Our Bounties: whether thou bestow them (on others) or withhold them, no account will be asked."
trs.203: [Allâh said to Sulaimân (Solomon)]: "This is Our gift: so spend you or withhold, no account will be asked (of you)."

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

trs.20: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
trs.85: His reward will be nearness to Us, and a good place to return to.
trs.22: And he enjoyed, indeed, a Near Approach to Us, and a beautiful Place of (Final) Return.
trs.203: And verily, for him is a near access to Us, and a good (final) return (Paradise).

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ

trs.20: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
trs.85: Bring to mind Our servant Job who cried to his Lord, ‘Satan has afflicted me with weariness and suffering.’
trs.22: Commemorate Our Servant Job. Behold he cried to his Lord: "The Evil One has afflicted me with distress and suffering!"
trs.203: And remember Our slave Ayyûb (Job), when he invoked his Lord (saying): "Verily Shaitân (Satan) has touched me with distress (by ruining my health) and torment (by ruining my wealth)!

verses.text_uthmani: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ

trs.20: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."
trs.85: ‘Stamp your foot! Here is cool water for you to wash in and drink,’
trs.22: (The command was given:) "Strike with thy foot: here is (water) wherein to wash, cool and refreshing, and (water) to drink."
trs.203: (Allâh said to him): "Strike the ground with your foot: This is (a spring of) water to wash in, cool and a (refreshing) drink."

translation.text: (is a spring of) water to bathe

verses.text_uthmani: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ

trs.20: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
trs.85: and We restored his family to him, with many more like them: a sign of Our mercy and a lesson to all who understand.
trs.22: And We gave him (back) his people, and doubled their number,- as a Grace from Ourselves, and a thing for commemoration, for all who have Understanding.
trs.203: And We gave him (back) his family, and along with them the like thereof, as a Mercy from Us, and a Reminder for those who understand.

verses.text_uthmani: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ

trs.20: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath."<sup foot_note=197221>1</sup> Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].
trs.85: ‘Take a small bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [her] with that so as not to break your oath.’ We found him patient in adversity; an excellent servant! He, too, always turned to God.
trs.22: "And take in thy hand a little grass, and strike therewith: and break not (thy oath)." Truly We found him full of patience and constancy. How excellent in Our service! ever did he turn (to Us)!
trs.203: "And take in your hand a bundle of thin grass and strike therewith (your wife), and break not your oath.<sup foot_note=154840>1</sup> Truly! We found him patient. How excellent a slave! Verily he was ever oft-returning in repentance (to Us)!

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ

trs.20: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
trs.85: Remember Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, all men of strength and vision.
trs.22: And commemorate Our Servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, possessors of Power and Vision.
trs.203: And remember Our slaves, Ibrâhîm (Abraham), Ishâq (Isaac), and Ya‘qûb (Jacob), (all) owners of strength (in worshipping Us) and (also) of religious understanding.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ

trs.20: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
trs.85: We caused them to be devoted to Us through their sincere remembrance of the Final Home:
trs.22: Verily We did choose them for a special (purpose)- proclaiming the Message of the Hereafter.
trs.203: Verily, We did choose them by granting them (a good thing, - i.e.) the remembrance of the Home [in the Hereafter and they used to make the people remember it, and also they used to invite the people to obey Allâh and to do good deeds for the Hereafter].

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

trs.20: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
trs.85: with Us they will be among the elect, the truly good.
trs.22: They were, in Our sight, truly, of the company of the Elect and the Good.
trs.203: And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best!

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ

trs.20: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
trs.85: And remember Our servants Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhu ’l-Kifl, each of them truly good.
trs.22: And commemorate Isma'il, Elisha, and Zul-Kifl: Each of them was of the Company of the Good.
trs.203: And remember Ismâ‘îl (Ishmael), Alyasa‘ (Elisha), and Dhul-Kifl (Isaiah), all are among the best.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ

trs.20: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
trs.85: This is a lesson. The devout will have a good place to return to:
trs.22: This is a Message (of admonition): and verily, for the righteous, is a beautiful Place of (Final) Return,-
trs.203: This is a Reminder. And verily, for the Muttaqûn (the pious - See V.2:2) is a good final return (Paradise),

verses.text_uthmani: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ

trs.20: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
trs.85: Gardens of lasting bliss with gates wide open.
trs.22: Gardens of Eternity, whose doors will (ever) be open to them;
trs.203: ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), whose doors will be opened for them.

verses.text_uthmani: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ

trs.20: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
trs.85: They will be comfortably seated; they will call for abundant fruit and drink;
trs.22: Therein will they recline (at ease): Therein can they call (at pleasure) for fruit in abundance, and (delicious) drink;
trs.203: Therein they will recline; therein they will call for fruits in abundance and drinks;

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ

trs.20: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances<sup foot_note=197222>1</sup> and of equal age.
trs.85: they will have well-matched [wives] with modest gaze.
trs.22: And beside them will be chaste women restraining their glances, (companions) of equal age.
trs.203: And beside them will be Qâsirât-at-Tarf [chaste females (wives) restraining their glances (desiring none except their husbands)], (and) of equal ages.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ

trs.20: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
trs.85: ‘This is what you are promised for the Day of Reckoning:
trs.22: Such is the Promise made, to you for the Day of Account!
trs.203: This it is what you (Al-Muttaqûn - the pious - see V.2:2) are promised for the Day of Reckoning!

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ

trs.20: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
trs.85: Our provision for you will never end.’
trs.22: Truly such will be Our Bounty (to you); it will never fail;-
trs.203: (It will be said to them)! Verily, this is Our Provision which will never finish.

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ

trs.20: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
trs.85: But the evildoers will have the worst place to return to:
trs.22: Yea, such! but - for the wrong-doers will be an evil place of (Final) Return!-
trs.203: This is so! And for the Tâghûn (transgressors, the disobedient to Allâh and His Messenger - disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh, criminals) will be an evil final return (Fire).

verses.text_uthmani: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ

trs.20: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
trs.85: Hell to burn in, an evil place to stay-
trs.22: Hell!- they will burn therein, - an evil bed (indeed, to lie on)!-
trs.203: Hell! Where they will burn, and worst (indeed) is that place to rest!

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ

trs.20: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
trs.85: all this will be theirs: let them taste it- a scalding, dark, foul fluid,
trs.22: Yea, such! - then shall they taste it,- a boiling fluid, and a fluid dark, murky, intensely cold!-
trs.203: This is so! Then let them taste it - a boiling fluid and dirty wound discharges.

verses.text_uthmani: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ

trs.20: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
trs.85: and other such torments.
trs.22: And other Penalties of a similar kind, to match them!
trs.203: And other (torments) of similar kind - all together!

verses.text_uthmani: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ

trs.20: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
trs.85: [It will be said], ‘Here is another crowd of people rushing headlong to join you.’ [The response will be], ‘They are not welcome! They will burn in the Fire.’
trs.22: Here is a troop rushing headlong with you! No welcome for them! truly, they shall burn in the Fire!
trs.203: This is a troop entering with you (in Hell), no welcome for them! Verily, they shall burn in the Fire!

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ

trs.20: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
trs.85: They will say to them, ‘You are not welcome! It was you who brought this on us, an evil place to stay,’
trs.22: (The followers shall cry to the misleaders:) "Nay, ye (too)! No welcome for you! It is ye who have brought this upon us! Now evil is (this) place to stay in!"
trs.203: (The followers of the misleaders will say): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you (misleaders) who brought this upon us (because you misled us in the world), so evil is this place to stay in!"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ

trs.20: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
trs.85: adding, ‘Our Lord, give double punishment to those who brought this upon us.’
trs.22: They will say: "Our Lord! whoever brought this upon us,- Add to him a double Penalty in the Fire!"
trs.203: They will say: "Our Lord! Whoever brought this upon us, add to him a double torment in the Fire!"

verses.text_uthmani: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ

trs.20: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?<sup foot_note=197223>1</sup>
trs.85: They will say, ‘Why do we not see those we thought were bad
trs.22: And they will say: "What has happened to us that we see not men whom we used to number among the bad ones?
trs.203: And they will say: "What is the matter with us that we see not men whom we used to count among the bad ones?"

verses.text_uthmani: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ

trs.20: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
trs.85: and took as a laughing-stock? Have our eyes missed them?’
trs.22: "Did we treat them (as such) in ridicule, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"
trs.203: Did we take them as an object of mockery, or have (our) eyes failed to perceive them?"

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ

trs.20: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
trs.85: This is how it will really be: the inhabitants of the Fire will blame one another in this way.
trs.22: Truly that is just and fitting,- the mutual recriminations of the People of the Fire!
trs.203: Verily, that is the very truth - the mutual dispute of the people of the Fire!

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,<sup foot_note=197224>1</sup>
trs.85: [Prophet] say, ‘I am only here to give warning. There is no god but God the One, the All Powerful,
trs.22: Say: "Truly am I a Warner: no god is there but the one Allah, Supreme and Irresistible,-
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "I am only a warner and there is no Ilâh (God) except Allâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh) the One, the Irresistible,

verses.text_uthmani: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ

trs.20: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might,<sup foot_note=197226>1</sup> the Perpetual Forgiver."<sup foot_note=197225>2</sup>
trs.85: Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between, the Almighty, the Most Forgiving.’
trs.22: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and all between,- Exalted in Might, able to enforce His Will, forgiving again and again."
trs.203: "The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ

trs.20: Say, "It is great news
trs.85: Say, ‘This message is a mighty one,
trs.22: Say: "That is a Message Supreme (above all),-
trs.203: Say: "That (this Qur’ân) is a great news,

verses.text_uthmani: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ

trs.20: From which you turn away.
trs.85: yet you ignore it.
trs.22: "From which ye do turn away!
trs.203: "From which you turn away!

verses.text_uthmani: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ

trs.20: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
trs.85: I have no knowledge of what those on high discuss:
trs.22: "No knowledge have I of the Chiefs on high, when they discuss (matters) among themselves.
trs.203: "I had no knowledge of the chiefs (angels) on high when they were disputing and discussing (about the creation of Adam).

verses.text_uthmani: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ

trs.20: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
trs.85: it is only revealed to me that I am here to give clear warning.’
trs.22: 'Only this has been revealed to me: that I am to give warning plainly and publicly."
trs.203: "Only this has been revealed to me, that I am a plain warner."

verses.text_uthmani: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ

trs.20: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
trs.85: Your Lord said to the angels, ‘I will create a man from clay.
trs.22: Behold, thy Lord said to the angels: "I am about to create man from clay:
trs.203: (Remember) when your Lord said to the angels: "Truly I am going to create man from clay".

verses.text_uthmani: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ

trs.20: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,<sup foot_note=197227>1</sup> then fall down to him in prostration."
trs.85: When I have shaped him and breathed from My Spirit into him, bow down before him.’
trs.22: "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
trs.203: So when I have fashioned him and breathed into him (his) soul created by Me, then you fall down prostrate to him."

verses.text_uthmani: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ

trs.20: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
trs.85: The angels all bowed down together,
trs.22: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together:
trs.203: So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them:

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

trs.20: Except Iblees;<sup foot_note=197228>1</sup> he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
trs.85: but not Iblis, who was too proud. He became a rebel.
trs.22: Not so Iblis: he was haughty, and became one of those who reject Faith.
trs.203: Except Iblîs (Satan): he was proud<sup foot_note=154841>1</sup> and was one of the disbelievers.

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands?<sup foot_note=197229>1</sup> Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
trs.85: God said, ‘Iblis, what prevents you from bowing down to the man I have made with My own hands? Are you too high and mighty?’
trs.22: (Allah) said: "O Iblis! What prevents thee from prostrating thyself to one whom I have created with my hands? Art thou haughty? Or art thou one of the high (and mighty) ones?"
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "O Iblîs (Satan)! What prevents you from prostrating yourself to one whom I have created with Both My Hands<sup foot_note=154842>1</sup>. Are you too proud (to fall prostrate to Adam) or are you one of the high exalted?"

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ

trs.20: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
trs.85: Iblis said, ‘I am better than him: You made me from fire, and him from clay.’
trs.22: (Iblis) said: "I am better than he: thou createdst me from fire, and him thou createdst from clay."
trs.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "I am better than he. You created me from fire, and You created him from clay."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
trs.85: ‘Get out of here! You are rejected:
trs.22: (Allah) said: "Then get thee out from here: for thou art rejected, accursed.
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "Then get out from here; for verily you are outcast.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ

trs.20: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
trs.85: My rejection will follow you till the Day of Judgement!’
trs.22: "And My curse shall be on thee till the Day of Judgment."
trs.203: "And verily My Curse is on you till the Day of Recompense."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ

trs.20: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
trs.85: but Iblis said, ‘My Lord, grant me respite until the Day when they are raised from the dead,’
trs.22: (Iblis) said: "O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are raised."
trs.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "My Lord! Give me then respite till the Day the (dead) are resurrected."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
trs.85: so He said, ‘You have respite
trs.22: (Allah) said: "Respite then is granted thee-
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "Verily! You are of those allowed respite."

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ

trs.20: Until the Day of the time well-known."
trs.85: till the Appointed Day.’
trs.22: "Till the Day of the Time Appointed."
trs.203: "Till the Day of the time appointed."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.
trs.85: Iblis said, ‘I swear by Your might! I will tempt all
trs.22: (Iblis) said: "Then, by Thy power, I will put them all in the wrong,-
trs.203: [Iblîs (Satan)] said: "By Your Might, then I will surely mislead them all,

verses.text_uthmani: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ

trs.20: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
trs.85: but Your true servants.’
trs.22: "Except Thy Servants amongst them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
trs.203: "Except Your chosen slaves amongst them (i.e. faithful, obedient, true believers of Islâmic Monotheism)."

verses.text_uthmani: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ

trs.20: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
trs.85: God said, ‘This is the truth- I speak only the truth-
trs.22: (Allah) said: "Then it is just and fitting- and I say what is just and fitting-
trs.203: (Allâh) said: "The Truth is - and the Truth I say -

verses.text_uthmani: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

trs.20: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
trs.85: I will fill Hell with you and all those that follow you.’
trs.22: "That I will certainly fill Hell with thee and those that follow thee,- every one."
trs.203: That I will fill Hell with you [Iblîs (Satan)] and those of them (mankind) that follow you, together."

verses.text_uthmani: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ

trs.20: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
trs.85: [Prophet], say, ‘I ask no reward from you for this, nor do I claim to be what I am not:
trs.22: Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I a pretender.
trs.203: Say (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم): "No wage do I ask of you for this (the Qur’ân), nor am I one of the Mutakallifûn (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

trs.20: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
trs.85: this is only a warning for all people.
trs.22: "This is no less than a Message to (all) the Worlds.
trs.203: "It (this Qur’ân) is only a Reminder for all the ‘Âlamîn (mankind and jinn).

verses.text_uthmani: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ

trs.20: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
trs.85: In time you will certainly come to know its truth.’
trs.22: "And ye shall certainly know the truth of it (all) after a while."
trs.203: "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while".
